🌟📺 Welcome to the official RTÉ KIDS YouTube channel! Dive into your favourite shows, including Nova Jones, The Big Pet Project, Space Camp, Royals Next Door, Flix, and many more new and upcoming favourites. Watch full episodes, best moments, behind-the-scenes clips, and special exclusives from top animation, live-action, and family entertainment, all in one place. We’ve got the best shows and fun content covered all year round!

Subscribe now so you never miss a moment, and check out RTÉ Player for even more amazing shows and content.
